content.comment_body: I have used [product_name] for years, although infrequently, and now I am reviving an old project. I encountered an issue I haven't seen before. After updating an existing program by adding three blocks, I downloaded it using an older PC with a serial port to a [product_name] [article_no]. The download worked, but the new parameters (blocks) do not appear on the module's display, even though the new logic operates correctly. I also created a new simple program (input to output); it works after download, but I can't view parameters on the module's display. I repeated these tests with another [product_name] ([version_no], left unused for years), using [product_name] [version_no], a new PC, and a network cable. I observed the same situation. Programs created and downloaded in the past show the blocks and parameters on the display, but additions or newly created programs work without showing information on the display. What could cause this? Is there any advice to resolve it? The programs run, but I need to view and adjust parameters directly on the module, not only by connecting to a PC.
Could you please upload your program as a ZIP file?

analysis.insight_summary: A user describes that after editing or creating new programs for [product_name] ([article_no] and [version_no]), the blocks and parameters are no longer visible on the display after download, even though the logic functions as intended. This issue occurs across different module versions, PCs, and connection types, while older programs retain full visibility. The feedback points to a possible regression or configuration affecting the ability to view and interact with blocks and parameters directly from the module.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to view and modify parameters and blocks directly on the [product_name] display after editing or creating programs in [product_name] [version_no], just as they could with previously created programs.
